data.name: Water Margin: Defiance
data.detailed_description:
Water Margin: Defiance is an action role-playing game. Set against the backdrop of the 14th-century Chinese literary classic Water Margin (Outlaws of the Marsh), it reinterprets a story about "destiny" and "choices."

Following the original novel's mythology, the game is built around the hidden premise that the "Thirty-Six Heavenly Spirits and Seventy-Two Earthly Demons" descended to the mortal world to cause chaos, while the "Thirty-Six Thunder Gods" were sent by heaven to subdue them. You play as a scion of a noble family caught in the crossfire of war — whether you are destined to be one of those demon-quelling Thunder Gods remains uncertain. Likewise, the true nature of those who hunt the demons — good or evil — is also unknown.

The story takes place during a critical period: after the Liangshan outlaws have accepted amnesty, following their northern campaign against the Liao, and as they march south to suppress the Fang La rebellion. It all begins with a seemingly ordinary request to borrow grain before the assault on Runzhou City…

When the outlaws of Liangshan are both righteous heroes fighting for justice and bloodthirsty demons who slaughter the innocent… as one who may be destined to vanquish demons, what will you do with the blade in your hand?

【Key Features】

⚔️ Forge Your Own Path, Let Justice Guide Your Blade
Good and evil, right and wrong — the choice is yours. Will you hold fast to your own sense of justice, or lose yourself in the bloodshed?

🔥 Feel Your Blood Surge into Battle
Experience fast-paced action combat. Face powerful enemies with your sword and skill.

🌿 Strike Unseen, Outwit Armies
Move through the shadows, use terrain and strategy to outmaneuver overwhelming forces, and breach fortified cities with cunning.

📖 A World of Water Margin — Where Legend and Reality Collide
A unique world rebuilt from the original classic. Between history and myth, step into a Mount Liang you have never seen before.

Only your choices will define the true will of heaven — “Dao”!

Choose your path between good and evil, fight in fast-paced combat, or strike unseen from the shadows. Step into a world where legend and reality intertwine.
